name: reload-rifle
note: CL-84 part 2: the marine's magazine change for the mag-fed long guns (GW-4, KR-7, Breacher-12). The support hand's path as keys over the reload (t is 0..1 of the gun's reload time), each key a named place on the marine or the gun plus an offset in the marine's own axes (x his side the support hand is on, y up, z forward), in metres. The game turns the places into points every frame and runs a smooth curve through them; the arm reaches it by IK. mag says what the magazine does from that time on.

places.well: the seated magazine's foot, where the palm strips it and pushes the new one home
places.pouch: the top of a magazine pouch on the support side: the carrier's when he wears it, else the belt's
places.below: the new magazine lined up under the well: the seated magazine's foot, 0.1 m further down the gun
